```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

## Setup

Building the local NCIt database requires Python and the Python
`rdflib` package. R communicates with Python using `reticulate`.

Check that Python is available:

```{r python-check, eval=TRUE}
reticulate::py_config()
```

Check that `rdflib` is available:

```{r rdflib-check, eval=TRUE}
reticulate::py_module_available("rdflib")
```

If required, `rdflib` can be installed into the Python environment
used by `reticulate`:

```{r rdflib-install, eval=TRUE}
reticulate::py_install("rdflib")
```


```{r download, eval=TRUE}
zip_file <- downloadNCIt_OWL_inferred()

owl_file <- extractNCIt_OWL_inferred(
  zip_file
)
```

```{r parse, eval=FALSE}
reticulate::source_python(
  system.file(
    "python",
    "parse_ncit_owl.py",
    package = "nciTools"
  )
)

g <- parse_ncit_owl(
  owl_file
)
```

```{r define desired path to database}

db_file <- file.path(
  dirname(owl_file),
  "NCIt.sqlite"
)

```

```{r database, eval=FALSE}
reticulate::source_python(
  system.file(
    "python",
    "create_db_from_graph.py",
    package = "nciTools"
  )
)



create_db_from_graph(
  g,
  db_file
)
```



```{r test queries against DB}

NCIt_sqlite_con = DBI::dbConnect(drv=RSQLite::SQLite(), db_file)

## concepts
DBI::dbGetQuery(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con, statement = 'SELECT * FROM concept LIMIT 6')

## relationships
DBI::dbGetQuery(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con, statement = 'SELECT * FROM relationship LIMIT 6')

## relationship types
DBI::dbGetQuery(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con, statement = 'SELECT * FROM relationship_type LIMIT 6') 

## relationship labels
DBI::dbGetQuery(conn = NCIt_sqlite_con, statement = 'SELECT * FROM relationship_type') |> 
  dplyr::pull(label) |> 
  unique()


```
